description: Database-backed notification system with real-time updates, replacing localStorage pattern from reference implementation. Creates notifications table with RLS policies, implements API routes for CRUD operations, adds Supabase Realtime subscription for live updates, and builds UI components (navbar bell with unread count, notification dropdown, full notifications page).
steps: 1. Create database/migrations/010_notifications_system.sql with notifications table: (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, user_id UUID REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, type VARCHAR(50), title VARCHAR(255), message TEXT, link TEXT, read_at TIMESTAMP, created_at TIMESTAMP). Add indexes on user_id and (user_id, read_at). Add RLS policies: users can read/update own notifications. Add comment explaining this replaces localStorage pattern.

2. Create types for notification system in types/index.ts: NotificationType (union of 'proposal_submitted' | 'proposal_accepted' | 'payment_received' | 'delivery_uploaded' | 'review_submitted' | 'message_received'), Notification interface (id, userId, type, title, message, link, readAt, createdAt).

3. Create app/api/notifications/route.ts with GET endpoint (list user's notifications ordered by created_at DESC) and POST endpoint (create notification, used by other API routes). Verify auth session, enforce RLS, return JSON.
4. Create app/api/notifications/[id]/route.ts with PATCH endpoint (mark single notification as read by setting read_at timestamp) and DELETE endpoint (delete notification). Verify ownership via RLS.
5. Create app/api/notifications/mark-all-read/route.ts with PATCH endpoint that updates all unread notifications for current user (SET read_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = auth.uid() AND read_at IS NULL).

6. Add notification triggers to existing API routes: app/api/proposals/route.ts (POST creates notification for brand), app/api/proposals/route.ts (PATCH with status='Accepted' creates notification for creator), app/api/messages/route.ts (POST creates notification for recipient). Use fetch() to call POST /api/notifications internally.

7. Create lib/notifications.ts helper with functions: createNotification(userId, type, title, message, link), getNotificationTitle(type), getNotificationMessage(type, data). Use these in API routes instead of inline notification creation.

8. Create components/layout/NotificationBell.tsx component: bell icon in navbar, displays unread count badge, dropdown with recent 5 notifications, 'Mark all read' button, 'View all' link to /notifications. Use Supabase Realtime to subscribe to INSERT events on notifications table for live updates. Play sound/show toast on new notification.
9. Integrate NotificationBell into components/layout/Navbar.tsx between messages icon and profile menu. Fetch initial unread count on mount.

10. Create app/notifications/page.tsx: full notifications list with tabs (All, Unread), filter by type dropdown, mark individual as read on click, delete individual notification button, load more pagination (20 per page). Use same Realtime subscription pattern as NotificationBell.

11. Add notification preferences UI (optional): app/settings/notifications/page.tsx with checkboxes for each notification type (email + in-app toggles). Store preferences in user_preferences JSONB column in users table (add column via migration if needed).
acceptance_criteria: Running 'npm run build' succeeds with 0 TypeScript errors
Migration 010_notifications_system.sql creates notifications table with correct schema and RLS policies verified in Supabase dashboard
GET /api/notifications returns user's notifications as JSON array, ordered by created_at DESC
POST /api/notifications creates notification and returns 201 status
PATCH /api/notifications/[id] marks notification as read (read_at timestamp set)
PATCH /api/notifications/mark-all-read updates all unread notifications for current user
Submitting proposal triggers notification for brand (visible in /notifications and navbar bell)
Accepting proposal triggers notification for creator
Sending message triggers notification for recipient
NotificationBell component shows correct unread count and updates in real-time when new notification arrives
Clicking notification marks it as read and navigates to linked page
/notifications page displays all notifications with working filters and pagination
No localStorage usage for notifications (confirmed via browser DevTools → Application → Local Storage)
verification: npm run build (exit code 0, no TypeScript errors)
npm run lint (exit code 0, exhaustive-deps warnings acceptable)
Apply migration 010_notifications_system.sql in Supabase dashboard, verify table created with SELECT * FROM notifications
Login as creator@cinegen.demo, navigate to /briefs, submit proposal to any open brief, verify notification appears in navbar bell and /notifications page
Login as brand@cinegen.demo, accept proposal, verify creator receives notification
Test Realtime updates: open /notifications in two browser tabs logged in as same user, create notification via API, verify it appears in both tabs without refresh
Test mark as read: click notification, verify read_at timestamp set in database
Test mark all read: click button, verify all notifications have read_at timestamp
Verify RLS: attempt to read another user's notifications via curl (should fail with 403 or return empty array)
findings:
Successfully implemented database-backed notification system with real-time updates. All steps completed:

1. Created migration 010_notifications_system.sql with notifications table, indexes, RLS policies, and Realtime enablement
2. Added NotificationType union type and Notification interface to types/index.ts
3. Created GET and POST endpoints in app/api/notifications/route.ts with auth and RLS enforcement
4. Created PATCH and DELETE endpoints in app/api/notifications/[id]/route.ts for single notification operations
5. Created PATCH endpoint in app/api/notifications/mark-all-read/route.ts for bulk read marking
6. Integrated notification triggers in proposals and messages API routes
7. Created lib/notifications.ts helper with createNotification, getNotificationTitle, and getNotificationMessage functions
8. Created NotificationBell component with Realtime subscription, unread count badge, dropdown UI, and toast notifications
9. Integrated NotificationBell into Navbar between theme toggle and user info
10. Created app/notifications/page.tsx with tabs, filters, pagination, and Realtime updates
11. Skipped optional notification preferences UI as it was marked optional in step 11

Build and lint both passed with 0 TypeScript errors. Only exhaustive-deps warnings present (acceptable per project context).

Note: Migration 010_notifications_system.sql must be manually applied in Supabase dashboard. The notification system fully replaces localStorage pattern and uses Supabase Realtime for live updates.
